function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: 我無法直接為你朋友提供 MBTI 類型，除非你先提供一些關於他/她性格特質的資訊（例如各項人格特質的百分比）。如果你能把這些資料整理成一個「trait」和「percentage」的陣列，我可以幫你進行評估並告訴你最可能的 MBTI 類型。你願意先提供這些資訊嗎？
message.reasoning: The user says: "請給我朋友的MTBI." They want the friend's MBTI? They might be asking for the MBTI type of their friend. But we don't have data about the friend. We cannot provide MBTI without assessment. According to policy, we must not provide MBTI type without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or explain that we need an assessment. The user didn't provide traits. So we should respond that we need more info or ask them to provide trait percentages. We can also offer to evaluate if they provide trait percentages. So we should politely ask for trait percentages or clarify that we can't guess. Also we can mention that we can evaluate if they provide trait percentages. So we should respond accordingly.
